title: Bulk upload
intro: Rows name reporting entities by id, so start from the template: its Reference sheet lists the reporting entities you can import for, with their ids.
limits: CSV or XLSX · up to {rows} · max {size}

preflight.tooLarge: That file is over the {cap} limit — split it and upload the parts.

summary.refusedOne: The one row in the file has a problem to fix.
summary.refusedMany: All {rows} in the file have a problem to fix.
summary.refusedNone: The file has no rows to import.
summary.retryPreviewOne: Fix it in your file and upload the file again.
summary.retryPreviewMany: Fix them in your file and upload the file again.
summary.retryAppliedOne: Fix it and upload a file containing only that row — re-sending the whole file would report the imported ones as duplicates.
summary.retryAppliedMany: Fix them and upload a file containing only those rows — re-sending the whole file would report the imported ones as duplicates.
summary.warnedOne: {count} row needs attention before it can be submitted — see below.
summary.warnedMany: {count} rows need attention before they can be submitted — see below.
summary.draftOne: The imported row is a draft: it counts towards no total and does not appear in the review queue until it is submitted below.
summary.draftMany: Imported rows are drafts: they count towards no total and do not appear in the review queue until they are submitted below.

tonnes.partialOne: {figure} across {counted} of {rows}; {missing} has no calculated figure
tonnes.partialMany: {figure} across {counted} of {rows}; {missing} have no calculated figure

applyConfirmOne: Import 1 row ({tonnes}). It arrives as a draft: it is not counted towards any total and does not appear in the review queue until it is submitted.
applyConfirmMany: Import {count} rows ({tonnes}). Each becomes its own record, and this cannot be undone in bulk. They arrive as drafts: they are not counted towards any total and do not appear in the review queue until they are submitted.
appliedOne: 1 record imported as a draft. Send it for review below to count it towards your inventory.
appliedMany: {count} records imported as drafts. Send them for review below to count them towards your inventory.
appliedNone: No rows were imported — the report below says why.

error.rateLimited: Too many import attempts. Wait a minute and try again — a dry run and an import each count towards the limit.
error.tooLarge: That file is over the {cap} limit. Split it and upload the parts.
error.roleForbidden: Your role cannot import activity records.

template.rateLimited: Too many template downloads. Wait a minute and try again.
template.failed: The template could not be downloaded.
